A1.justification: Both complete 19-page PDFs describe AGORABENCH. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices support reliable comparison, including matching v1 Section 6 to v2 Appendix B.

before.justification: V1 reports original experiments involving 1.26 million synthetic instances, six data generators, and 99 student models, with benchmark results and intrinsic-data analyses.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experiments and results, including the quantity and prompt-format studies relocated to Appendix B.

M1.justification: The three data-generation procedures and response-only supervised fine-tuning remain unchanged. The added discussion of PGR versus intrinsic metrics explains the existing framework without changing its procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same math, code, and instruction-following domains, nine generation settings, seed datasets, and six evaluation benchmarks. The larger-data scenarios in v2 Appendix B already appear in v1 Section 6.

E2.justification: The main comparison retains GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Llama-3.1-Instruct at 8B, 70B, and 405B. The comparator subsets and prompt variants in Figure 7 and Table 5 also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Both retain 10K generated instances per core setting, the same student and reference models, data processing, benchmarks, and Table 6 hyperparameters. The scaling and prompt-comparison protocols are relocated without reported setting changes.

E4.justification: The quantity/cost and prompt-format ablations are preserved in Appendix B, and the intrinsic-metric PCA and regression studies remain. Figure 5 contains an isolated numerical-label correction, but no new or substantively revised analytical experiment is documented.

E5.justification: Table 6 retains random seed 42, and Figures 4 and 6 retain the same regression significance and R-squared reporting. No repeated-run counts, uncertainty estimates, or statistical procedures are added or changed.

E6.justification: Figure 5 changes the Skywork reward-model score's PC-4 loading from -0.58 to +0.58, making the annotation consistent with the existing positive heatmap color. Numerical entries in Tables 2–5 and 7–8 and the other reported PCA/regression results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical notation, data-generation formulation, and PGR definition in Equations 1–2 are unchanged. The new metric discussion is conceptual explanation, without new assumptions, derivations, or proofs.

C1.justification: The central claims about standardized generator evaluation, differing generator strengths, limited predictive value of problem-solving ability, and the importance of intrinsic data properties, cost, and prompts are retained. Shortening the introduction and conclusion does not change their substantive scope.

C2.justification: V2 adds a dedicated limitations and risks section absent from v1, substantially expanding qualifications about generalization beyond Llama-3.1-8B, model-dependent perplexity, larger-scale generator rankings, and proprietary-model transparency. Section 2 also explicitly explains PGR as complementary to intrinsic metrics.

D1.justification: Training and inference hyperparameters, hardware, evaluation libraries, classification and judging prompts, and code/meta-prompt access information are retained. Their appendix locations and letters change, without additional implementation disclosures.

R1.justification: The new PGR-versus-intrinsic-metrics paragraph explicitly positions PGR relative to prior intrinsic data-quality evaluation. Appendix A and the cited-work set otherwise remain unchanged; several reference edits update publication metadata rather than introduce new works.

P1.justification: V2 moves Section 6 to Appendix B, shortens the introduction and conclusion, condenses some metric descriptions, and adds the PGR discussion, limitations, and acknowledgements. These are limited revisions within an otherwise retained narrative.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is resized, Figure 7 and Table 5 move to the appendix, and Table 6 and the prompt boxes are rearranged. Table 4's caption is shortened. The existing visual designs and display inventory are largely retained.

improvement.justification: V2 improves interpretive clarity by explicitly discussing applicability limits and PGR's relationship to intrinsic metrics, and corrects Figure 5's inconsistent loading sign. The experimental evidence remains available despite relocation of analyses. These changes improve qualification and reporting accuracy without materially expanding empirical validation.
